tracking: ADR-0312 (lane E2, G3): API-only cost-per-outcome and spend-budget routes; the dashboard cards are posted on #453

gaps.GET /v1/cost-outcomes: pages recorded outcomes (merged PR, workflow run, accepted change, completed work item) with each one's metered spend; a non-admin sees only their own
gaps.GET /v1/cost-outcomes/summary: per-project or per-cost-centre cost per outcome, metered by kind, with imported spend beside it (never combined)
gaps.POST /v1/cost-outcomes/refresh: runs the outcome recorder now (admin, audited); the scheduler runs it every five minutes
gaps.GET /v1/user-spend-budgets: lists every person's spend budget (alert only): amount, window and alert threshold
gaps.GET /v1/users/:userId/spend-budget: a person's spend budget with their metered spend in the window and imported spend beside it (self or admin)
gaps.PUT /v1/users/:userId/spend-budget: sets a person's spend budget; crossing its threshold raises a governance alert (audited)
gaps.DELETE /v1/users/:userId/spend-budget: removes a person's spend budget, a relaxation (settings_relax step-up, audited)
